nodes.rationale: Running elevated, Invoke-Expression, runtime Add-Type, downloads and unquoted Start-Process paths are banned.

nodes.rationale: Restore value documented, missing vs other value distinguished, allowlisted path, declared type, never touch ACLs/owners.

nodes.label: ExternalLink http/https-only restriction
nodes.rationale: From an elevated process ShellExecute would open anything.

nodes.label: Audit history convention
nodes.rationale: Dated report per audit; SECURITY.md is the living document, reports are snapshots.

nodes.label: Threat model of elevated portable exe
nodes.norm_label: threat model of elevated portable exe
nodes.rationale: -requireAdmin + -noConsole + portable: risks ranked as (1) leaving machine less secure, (2) irreversible breakage, (3) running foreign code as admin.

nodes.label: actions/checkout pinned by SHA
nodes.rationale: A tag like @v6 can be silently repointed by the action owner (supply chain); bumping requires consciously changing the SHA.

nodes.label: Push trigger without paths filter
nodes.rationale: Repo commits directly to master, so every push must run Semgrep, not only those touching the workflow.

nodes.label: New-ChipMenu / New-ViewMenu deliberate duplication
nodes.rationale: Mechanics differ (commands vs checkboxes); merging would churn a tested component.

nodes.label: Seven-layer architecture (Design/Engine/Index/core/Data/Components/Views)
nodes.rationale: One folder per layer, never skip a layer downward; load order matters only because data registers on load.

nodes.label: ps2exe pinned to 1.0.18 from PSGallery
nodes.rationale: Unpinned installs could pull different compiler code or another registered repository.

nodes.label: Why Snyk does not fit
nodes.rationale: No dependency manifests; Snyk Code would overlap with Semgrep + PSSA.

nodes.label: Audit recommendations (sign exe, persist rollback, Windows CI, narrow prefix)
nodes.norm_label: audit recommendations (sign exe, persist rollback, windows ci, narrow prefix)

nodes.label: $RegistrySnapshots in-memory rollback
nodes.rationale: Accepted temporarily; pending persist -> undo button -> restore point prompt.

nodes.label: $RegistryWriteAllowedValues per-value allowlist
nodes.rationale: Lets specific values (service Start, Tcpip params) in without opening whole branches.

nodes.label: $RegistryWriteAllowlist path allowlist
nodes.rationale: No denylist: what is not on the list is not touched (blocked).

nodes.label: Broad HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft prefix risk
nodes.rationale: Allowlist gates paths not semantics; prefix reaches Defender/Update/SmartScreen GPO keys. Mitigated by value-name denylist.

nodes.label: Build pipeline (build.ps1 -> _combined.ps1 -> ps2exe)
nodes.rationale: ps2exe accepts only one input file, so build.ps1 inlines the whole project.

nodes.label: AppHost harness (loads app without window)
nodes.rationale: Reads main.ps1 with the same regexes as build.ps1, validating the packaging contract; disarms registry writes.

nodes.label: UI Automation smoke test on exe (pending)
nodes.norm_label: ui automation smoke test on exe (pending)

nodes.label: Wiring.Tests.ps1 main.ps1 probe
nodes.rationale: Only way to catch closure bug (rule 4), which fails on click only under main.ps1.

nodes.label: Tester agent
nodes.rationale: Reports the truth about code state; reproduces failures but does not fix them; a single-host result is not a verification.

nodes.label: versionado skill
nodes.rationale: Public GitHub remote: always commit locally, push only when asked; never force-push/amend/rebase published history.

nodes.label: Test suite (no Pester)
nodes.rationale: Windows ships Pester 3.4 only; avoiding Install-Module, a 40-line TestKit does the job.

nodes.label: One commit by default policy
nodes.rationale: Split only for truly independent work; more than 2 commits per normal session is over-splitting.

nodes.label: Test in both hosts (5.1 and pwsh 7)
nodes.norm_label: test in both hosts (5.1 and pwsh 7)
nodes.rationale: exe runs global scope on 5.1, main.ps1 script scope on 7; bugs appear in only one.

nodes.label: Find-Visuals must not be wrapped in @()
nodes.norm_label: find-visuals must not be wrapped in @()

nodes.label: Why Playwright does not fit
nodes.rationale: Playwright automates browsers; WPF has no DOM.

nodes.label: All visible text passes through T
nodes.norm_label: all visible text passes through t

nodes.label: settings.json in %APPDATA%
nodes.rationale: Exe is portable and may live in a non-writable folder; corrupt JSON is ignored.

nodes.label: Translation by original English text
nodes.rationale: Category files stay readable in English and are still translated; missing translations fall back to English.

nodes.label: @@EMBED_DIR@@ / @@EMBED_XAML@@ build markers
nodes.rationale: build.ps1 only understands these markers; loose files loaded by dot-sourcing work in dev but fail compiled.

nodes.label: Dev agent
nodes.rationale: Implements changes following CLAUDE.md; must load powershell-engineer always and security-reviewer when writing to the system; stops instead of improvising architecture.

nodes.label: graphify graph limitations
nodes.rationale: 0 of 1355 edges linked code with docs, so natural-language queries return doc noise; use graph only for path/explain on code symbols.

nodes.label: No .GetNewClosure() in event handlers
nodes.rationale: Closures bind to a dynamic module where script functions are invisible; only fails under main.ps1. Pass data via Tag.

nodes.label: UTF-8 with BOM rule
nodes.rationale: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads BOM-less scripts as ANSI and fails with 'Token inesperado'.

nodes.label: core/Registry/CategoryState.ps1 (rellena el Current al entrar en la seccion)
nodes.norm_label: core/registry/categorystate.ps1 (rellena el current al entrar en la seccion)

nodes.label: Declaracion New-Setting con -Registry, Recommended y Default
nodes.norm_label: declaracion new-setting con -registry, recommended y default

nodes.label: Sin valor de restauracion real no se puede aplicar un ajuste
nodes.norm_label: sin valor de restauracion real no se puede aplicar un ajuste

nodes.label: Los agentes son roles; el conocimiento vive en skills
nodes.norm_label: los agentes son roles; el conocimiento vive en skills

nodes.label: Nadie cierra una tarea sin las dos suites verdes
nodes.norm_label: nadie cierra una tarea sin las dos suites verdes

nodes.label: Computed registry status (optimized/factory/custom/unknown)
nodes.rationale: Status is computed where it is read (Update-CategoryRegistryState), not where painted; a setting with -Registry carries no -Tags since they'd be the invented version of the same thing.

nodes.label: Test suite (tests/Run-Tests.ps1 -BothHosts, no Pester)
nodes.rationale: Windows ships Pester 3.4, incompatible with modern syntax; harness is dependency-free.

nodes.label: Tests do not write user settings (AppHost redirects $AppSettingsPath)
nodes.norm_label: tests do not write user settings (apphost redirects $appsettingspath)

nodes.label: Update-UiNow is a DoEvents (disable hit-testing during reads)
nodes.norm_label: update-uinow is a doevents (disable hit-testing during reads)

nodes.label: Setting status states (optimized/factory/custom/unknown)
nodes.rationale: Absent value is factory; with nothing declared status is unknown since 'custom' would be an accusation without proof.

nodes.label: Test coverage areas (core, UI, wiring, rules, security invariants)
nodes.norm_label: test coverage areas (core, ui, wiring, rules, security invariants)
nodes.rationale: Playwright automates browsers, not WPF; e2e would need UI Automation.

nodes.label: Add-Type literal C# in SystemBackdrop.ps1 and WorkArea.ps1
nodes.norm_label: add-type literal c# in systembackdrop.ps1 and workarea.ps1

nodes.label: Attack surface (settings.json, registry reads, -Link URLs, Recommended/Default)
nodes.norm_label: attack surface (settings.json, registry reads, -link urls, recommended/default)

nodes.label: ExternalLink http/https-only gate (Test-ExternalLinkAllowed)
nodes.rationale: ShellExecute from an elevated process would open anything; only absolute http/https URIs reach Start-Process.

nodes.label: Mica and custom gradient are mutually exclusive
nodes.norm_label: mica and custom gradient are mutually exclusive
nodes.rationale: System material only shows through a translucent window, which cannot have its own background; dwmapi call never throws and falls back to opaque.

nodes.label: Code execution prohibitions (no iex, no network, no dynamic Add-Type)
nodes.norm_label: code execution prohibitions (no iex, no network, no dynamic add-type)

nodes.label: Threat model (elevated, no console, portable, unsigned)
nodes.norm_label: threat model (elevated, no console, portable, unsigned)
nodes.rationale: Three real risks: lowering security posture, irreversible breakage, executing foreign code as admin.

nodes.label: Security-degrading value denylist (AllowsSecurityTradeoff)
nodes.rationale: Settings that lower security are allowed but cannot be called Recommended, must describe lost protection, are off by default and require AllowsSecurityTradeoff.

nodes.label: Always RegistryView::Registry64
nodes.rationale: A 32-bit build would silently redirect HKLM\SOFTWARE to Wow6432Node.

nodes.label: Supply chain (ps2exe pinned 1.0.18, unsigned exe, Semgrep CI)
nodes.norm_label: supply chain (ps2exe pinned 1.0.18, unsigned exe, semgrep ci)

nodes.label: Pending work (persistent rollback, restore point, -Registry elsewhere)
nodes.norm_label: pending work (persistent rollback, restore point, -registry elsewhere)

nodes.label: Frozen brushes (Set-AppTheme, Resources.Add)
nodes.rationale: WPF freezes shareable SolidColorBrushes on XAML load; indexer stores a PSObject wrapper that WPF rejects, so Resources.Add() is used.

nodes.label: Get-Palette and $GradientTokens (two color families)
nodes.rationale: Each gradient is composed from two palette keys so no color is written twice; Get-GradientKey falls back to the flat key.

nodes.label: CategoryIndex (order / Visible / Locked)
nodes.rationale: Locked sets IsEnabled=false so WPF stops delivering mouse input; unlisted categories still appear at the end unlocked (Get-UnlistedCategories).

nodes.label: Design system (palette, gradients, live theme switch)
nodes.norm_label: design system (palette, gradients, live theme switch)

nodes.label: Register-Category / New-Setting declaration
nodes.rationale: New-Setting infers the control: with -Options a dropdown, otherwise a toggle.

nodes.label: graphify graph: uses and limits
nodes.rationale: No edge connects code to documentation, so natural-language queries return doc nodes and miss code; use path/explain on code symbols only, and refresh with --update.

nodes.label: Layered architecture (7 layer folders)
nodes.rationale: Never skip a layer downward; folder name dictates contents. Load order matters only because data registers itself on load (Register-Category lives in ui/Engine).

nodes.label: Set-AppSetting / settings.json in %APPDATA%
nodes.rationale: Portable exe may live in a non-writable folder; corrupt JSON ignored.

nodes.label: Router / Show-View
nodes.rationale: Calling views directly loses router state so language change repaints the wrong screen.

nodes.label: Sidebar built by code (Build-Sidebar, Set-NavSelection, Sync-NavSelection)
nodes.norm_label: sidebar built by code (build-sidebar, set-navselection, sync-navselection)
nodes.rationale: Entry without View does not navigate on purpose so the menu never marks one thing while showing another; selection decided in Show-View since screens can be reached without the menu.

nodes.label: Translation via T (source-text keyed)
nodes.rationale: A literal without T stays English and is invisible to Get-MissingTranslations; language change requires repaint via Update-UiLanguage because text has no DynamicResource.

nodes.label: Languages (Register-Language, Get-MissingTranslations)
nodes.rationale: Translation keyed by original English text so category data files stay untouched and readable; language names are never translated.

nodes.label: XAML view containers (HeaderTitleArea, HeaderActionsArea, MainContent)
nodes.rationale: Views are built in code and injected through PageHeader so switching screens does not recreate the window.

nodes.label: User data and activity log export
nodes.norm_label: user data and activity log export

nodes.label: Normalize-PsEncoding PostToolUse hook
nodes.rationale: Hook lives in OptimizadorPC/.claude/settings.local.json and is not loaded when the session opens from the parent folder.

nodes.label: Agent delegation policy
nodes.rationale: Agents start cold; delegate only with two or more independent fronts, launched in parallel.

nodes.label: Test in both hosts (PS 5.1 exe and pwsh 7 main.ps1)
nodes.norm_label: test in both hosts (ps 5.1 exe and pwsh 7 main.ps1)
nodes.rationale: The .exe runs in global scope under 5.1 and main.ps1 in script scope under 7; some bugs appear only in one.

nodes.label: Add-HoverLift static wrapper (RenderTransform hit-test loop)
nodes.rationale: RenderTransform also moves the hit zone, causing an infinite MouseEnter/Leave loop; the listener must be a stationary wrapper.

nodes.label: Live backdrop at 20 fps without BlurEffect
nodes.norm_label: live backdrop at 20 fps without blureffect
nodes.rationale: Nobody distinguishes 20 vs 60 fps on a 30s path; radial gradients fade to transparent instead of expensive blur. An app named Optimizador PC must not waste CPU.
